definition: Sales value generated after recorded discounts.
note: Map the generic field to the dataset before calculating.

definition: Average revenue generated by each distinct order.
note: Use distinct orders rather than row count.

definition: Share of revenue remaining after cost of goods sold.
note: Cost definitions must be confirmed with Finance.

definition: Share of distinct orders or items returned by customers.
note: Choose order-level or item-level measurement consistently.

definition: Share of eligible visits or users that complete a purchase.
note: Confirm whether the denominator is users or sessions.

definition: Share of qualified leads that successfully enrol.
note: Define qualified-lead eligibility before calculation.

definition: Share of enrolled learners who complete the course.
note: Set a consistent completion cutoff date.

definition: Share of learners who remain active at the end of the measurement period.
note: Exclude learners who were not yet eligible for the full period.

definition: Average sales and marketing spend required to acquire one new student.
note: Use incremental spend when evaluating a specific campaign.

definition: Average recognised revenue generated per paying learner.
note: Do not mix booked and recognised revenue.

definition: Share of available room nights that were sold.
note: Exclude out-of-order rooms only if the business definition requires it.

definition: Average room revenue earned per occupied room night.
note: Exclude taxes and non-room revenue unless policy says otherwise.

definition: Room revenue generated per available room night.
note: RevPAR also equals ADR multiplied by occupancy as a decimal.

definition: Share of eligible reservations that were cancelled.
note: Define whether no-shows are included.

definition: Average number of occupied nights per completed stay.
note: Use completed stays for a realised measure.

definition: Share of ad impressions that produced a click.
note: Use the same platform attribution window.

definition: Average media cost for each recorded click.
note: Handle campaigns with zero clicks separately.

definition: Average campaign spend required to generate one eligible lead.
note: Remove duplicate and invalid leads before calculation.

definition: Average attributable sales and marketing cost per new customer.
note: Agree on attribution scope before comparing channels.

definition: Revenue attributed to advertising for each unit of ad spend.
note: ROAS is not the same as profit or ROI.

definition: Share of eligible leads that become customers or won opportunities.
note: Confirm the exact conversion event.

definition: Share of closed opportunities that were won.
note: Exclude open opportunities from the denominator.

definition: Average elapsed time from opportunity creation to closure.
note: Calculate on closed opportunities and report the median too.

definition: Average booked value of won opportunities.
note: Use one consistent currency and booking definition.

definition: Open qualified pipeline value relative to the sales target.
note: Pipeline period and target period must match.

definition: Net interest income earned relative to average interest-earning assets.
note: Use the institution's approved annualisation convention.

definition: Share of the loan portfolio classified as non-performing.
note: Apply the regulatory delinquency definition.

definition: Operating expenses relative to operating income.
note: Lower values generally indicate better operating efficiency.

definition: Net income generated relative to average total assets.
note: Use average assets across the period.

definition: Gross loans outstanding relative to customer deposits.
note: Interpret alongside liquidity requirements.

definition: Average elapsed time between patient arrival and service start.
note: Report percentiles because averages can hide long waits.

definition: Share of available bed-days that were occupied.
note: Confirm treatment of closed or unavailable beds.

definition: Share of eligible discharges followed by an unplanned readmission within the defined window.
note: Apply clinical exclusions and the approved time window.

definition: Average inpatient days per completed admission.
note: Use completed inpatient stays only.

definition: Share of submitted claims denied by the payer.
note: Track initial and final denials separately.

definition: Combined availability performance and quality effectiveness of equipment.
note: Express each component as a decimal before multiplication.

definition: Share of produced units that fail the defined quality standard.
note: Define whether rework units count as defects.

definition: Share of units meeting quality standards without rework.
note: Measure at a clearly defined process stage.

definition: Share of scheduled production time lost to unplanned downtime.
note: Separate planned maintenance from unplanned events.

definition: Cost of goods sold relative to average inventory value.
note: Use average opening and closing inventory at minimum.

definition: Share of eligible deliveries completed on or before the promised time.
note: Define grace periods and customer-caused delays.

definition: Share of available vehicle time spent in productive use.
note: Productive use must be consistently defined.

definition: Total fleet operating cost incurred per kilometre travelled.
note: State which fixed and variable costs are included.

definition: Share of travelled distance completed without a productive load.
note: Use consistent trip and repositioning rules.

definition: Share of eligible drivers who leave during the measurement period.
note: Separate voluntary and involuntary exits where possible.

definition: Normalised recurring subscription revenue active in a month.
note: Exclude one-time fees and usage revenue unless policy includes them.

definition: Share of starting customers lost during the measurement period.
note: New customers acquired during the period are not in the denominator.

definition: Share of monthly active users who are active on an average day.
note: Use the same qualifying activity definition for DAU and MAU.

definition: Average recurring revenue generated per active paying account.
note: Use account rather than user count for B2B products.

definition: Estimated customer lifetime value relative to acquisition cost.
note: Document the exact LTV model and cohort assumptions.
